title: Vocabulary Quiz — Unit 3 Vocabulary Extension: University life
subtitle: Words and phrases about study and university

words.vi: nộp đơn vào một trường/tổ chức
words.def: to ask officially to join a college or university
words.sent: Students who want a place must ___ to a university before the deadline.

words.vi: danh mục tài liệu tham khảo
words.def: a list of the books and articles you used for a piece of work
words.sent: Put every book you used in the ___ at the end of your essay.

words.vi: bài làm trong khoá học (không phải thi cuối kỳ)
words.def: work students do during a course, not in the final exam
words.sent: Thirty per cent of my final mark comes from ___.

words.def: a part of a college where one subject is taught
words.sent: She works in the English ___ at the university.

words.def: a long piece of writing that you do as part of a course
words.sent: He is writing a 10,000-word ___ about climate change.

words.def: to study a subject to find out new information about it
words.sent: Many students ___ in the library before they write an essay.

words.def: people who study at the same place as you
words.sent: I often study with my ___ in the evening.

words.vi: năm nghỉ giữa phổ thông và đại học
words.def: a year between school and university that you spend travelling or working
words.sent: After school she took a ___ and travelled around Asia.

words.def: to get the marks you need in an exam
words.sent: You must ___ in your exams to get into this university.

words.vi: tốt nghiệp với bằng loại tốt
words.def: to get a high mark in the qualification at the end of university
words.sent: He studied hard to ___ and find a good job.

words.def: to stop doing a course before you finish it
words.sent: She decided to ___ French because it was too difficult.

words.def: a large room where students sit and listen to lectures
words.sent: More than two hundred students sat in the ___.

words.def: to use someone else's words or ideas as if they were your own
words.sent: If you ___ another writer's work, you may fail the course.

words.def: a student who already has a degree and studies for a higher one
words.sent: A ___ is studying for a master's degree.

words.def: to use the exact words of a writer to support what you say
words.sent: In your essay you should ___ your sources.

words.def: to be given money for a particular purpose
words.sent: The research team will ___ from the government.

words.def: a plan that shows the subjects or books in a course
words.sent: The ___ lists all the books we must read this year.

words.def: the people who are employed to teach in a school or university
words.sent: The ___ at this college are very friendly.

words.def: the money students pay to be taught at a university
words.sent: Many students borrow money to pay their ___.

words.vi: sinh viên đại học (chưa tốt nghiệp)
words.def: a student who is studying for a first university degree
words.sent: An ___ usually studies for three or four years.
